battle.name: 宋收復河、岷等州之戰
battle.theater: 甘肅熙河路河洮岷諸州
battle.brief: 熙寧六年，神宗用王韶《平戎策》，正月集兵熙州，二月出師攻河州，斬木征部眾千餘，俘其妻瞎天牟與子續木洛；八月經冶木河谷入洮州界，破巴珍覺，斷其後援，河、洮、岷諸州相繼歸宋，置熙河路。陣中以弓弩長槍為主，長柄窄刃大斧用於破柵斬馬；維京長斧形制雖殊，用途相近，可作此役步戰兵器之比擬。

kit.name: 維京長斧
kit.history: 刃很長，斧面窄。北歐的船隊帶著它，也帶著它上岸。

countries: 交戰一方是北宋。王韶以洮河安撫司主管、兼領熙河路經略安撫使之權，統一指揮取熙、河、洮、岷、疊、宕諸州之役；樞密院掌調兵，戶部與三司供軍儲，秦鳳、涇原、環慶三路邊軍在側翼策應，另以歸附的蕃兵隨軍引導。兵種以禁軍為骨幹，步軍用長槍、刀與斧，騎兵以弓箭射擊為主，又徵發民夫、蕃戶轉運糧草。另一方是吐蕃。唃廝羅死後，其子董氈承襲可汗名位，但河湟一帶的吐蕃諸部各自分立，熙州、河州一線由首領木征與其弟巴珍覺控制，並以河州城與冶木河谷的險隘為依托。交戰雙方在西北形成宋對吐蕃的局部攻勢，而西夏則在東面牽制宋軍，隨後更與吐蕃首領阿里骨密約瓜分熙、河、岷三州，把熙河開邊變成兩面受敵的局面。
countriesEn: One side was the Northern Song. Wang Shao, as Director of the Taohe Pacification Commission and holding authority over the Xihe Circuit Military and Pacification Office, commanded the operations that took the prefectures of Xi, He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang; the Bureau of Military Affairs handled troop dispatch, the Ministry of Revenue and the Tax Commission supplied funds and stores, and the frontier armies of the Qinfeng, Jingyuan and Huanqing circuits supported the flanks, with submitted tribal fighters serving as guides. Infantry of the Imperial Guard formed the core, spearmen and swordsmen and axe-men in the ranks, while the cavalry fought mainly with the bow, and porters and tribal households were conscripted to move grain. The other side was Tibet. After Tasiluoge died, his third son Dongzhan inherited the khan's title, but the Tibetan bands around Huangshui had already fragmented, and the districts of Xi and He were held in practice by the chieftain Muzheng and his brother Bazhenjue, who relied on the fortress of He Prefecture and the defiles of Yemu Valley. The result was a local Song offensive against Tibet, while Western Xia pinned Song troops on the eastern front and later, in a secret compact with the Tibetan leader Aligu, agreed to divide the region between them, turning the opening of Xihe into a campaign fought on two fronts.
people: 宋神宗趙頊是發動者。熙寧年間他力排朝議，聽從王韶《平戎策》「欲取西夏，先復河湟」之說，詔令王韶便宜行事，開熙河一路。王韶（1030年至1081年），字子純，號敷陽子，江州人，進士出身，是全役統帥：先取熙州築城置路、經營屯田，再分兵進取河、洮、岷諸州。吐蕃方面，木征是熙河地區的實際首領，先失河州又奪回，最終在熙寧七年兵敗投降，賜名趙思忠；其弟巴珍覺於熙寧六年八月在洮州界被王韶擊敗。董氈承襲吐蕃可汗名位，名分最高而實力有限，與木征時合時離。熙寧七年二月河州失守，守將景思立輕敵戰敗而死，王韶與李憲率二萬兵疾馳熙州解圍，再進白城追擊，一舉收復。主張慎重者如司馬光、韓琦，先後上書言開邊之害；蔡挺在慶州、沈起在秦州各與邊事相關，後者更因與王韶爭功而事敗貶官。
peopleEn: The initiator on the Song side was Emperor Shenzong Zhao Xu. During the Xining era he overrode the court, adopted Wang Shao's Pingrong Plan — to recover Hehuang first in order to strike at Western Xia — and issued orders allowing Wang Shao to act on his own discretion and to open the Xihe circuit. Wang Shao (1030–1081), courtesy name Zichun, art name Fuyangzi, a native of Jiangzhou and a jinshi of the imperial examination, was the overall commander: he first seized Xizhou, built walls, set up the circuit and opened tuntian, and only then advanced in columns on He, Tao and Min. On the Tibetan side Muzheng was the effective ruler of the Xihe region; he lost He Prefecture, retook it, and finally surrendered after his defeat in the seventh year of Xining, being granted the name Zhao Si Zhong. His brother Bazhenjue was beaten by Wang Shao in Tao Prefecture in the eighth month of 1073. Dongzhan inherited the Tibetan khan's title with the highest name but limited real power, cooperating with and quarrelling with Muzheng by turns. When He Prefecture fell in the second month of 1074, its commander Jing Sili was defeated and killed for overconfidence, and Wang Shao together with Li Xian led twenty thousand men in a forced march to relieve the siege, then pressed on to Baicheng and reversed the situation in a single stroke. Advocates of caution such as Sima Guang and Han Qi memorialised in turn against the cost of the frontier policy; Cai Ting at Qing Prefecture and Shen Qi at Qin Prefecture were also involved, the latter being demoted after his rivalry with Wang Shao over credit for the campaign.
kits: 卡面這件維京長斧，北歐稱 Dane axe，特點是柄長、刃長而薄、斧面窄而直，單面開刃，主要用於船上近身砍劈與破甲。本戰役裡當然沒有北歐兵器入陣，但可以拿它作比擬：北宋步軍確實使用長柄斧，《武經總要》器圖所收的斧類柄長刃薄，形制與丹麥斧相近，多用於斬拒馬、砍鹿角木柵、破攻城器械，以及守城時對付攀城者，其中帶鈎的長柄斧更可在軍陣中鉤殺敵兵。不過決定此役勝負的並非斧，而是弓弩與長槍。熙河軍中最重火力是弓，神臂弓、蹶張弩與箭矢覆蓋遠近，步軍以長槍結陣抵拒騎兵，騎兵多帶斬馬刀與長槍，裝束則有札甲、鎖子甲與笠盔。攻城用雲梯、飛雲梯、井陘車、撞車與拒馬；北宋前期已有火藥箭與火箭，《武經總要》列霹靂震天雷、火毒煙炮，可用來焚燒木柵與城樓。後勤靠秦鳳轉運與熙河屯田，馬匹自慶州、原州牽運，糧秣以牛、驢負載。
kitsEn: The card shows a Viking long axe, the Dane axe, whose marks are a long haft, a long thin blade, a narrow straight head and a single cutting edge, used above all for close-quarter boarding and cleaving on ships. No northern European weapon of the kind stood in the line at this battle, but the axe can serve as a comparison: Song infantry did indeed carry long-handled axes, and the axe types in the illustrated equipment registers of the Wujing Zongyao have long hafts and thin blades close to the Dane axe, being used to cut down horse-blocking barriers, sapped palisades and siege works, and to strike men climbing the walls; some long-handled axes with hooks could hook and pull down enemy soldiers in the battle line. What decided the campaign, however, was not the axe but the bow, crossbow and spear. The Xihe armies relied above all on missile power: powerful Shenbi bows, tension crossbows and arrows covered the near and far ground; infantry formed spear formations to check cavalry; cavalry carried horse-cutting sabres and long spears, and their kit included plated and mail armour and leather-helmed caps. For sieges the Song used scaling ladders, flying ladders, well-head carts, battering rams and abatis; gunpowder arrows and fire arrows were already recorded in the early Northern Song, and the Wujing Zongyao lists the thunder-shaking bomb and the smoke shell, usable for burning palisades and tower roofs. Supply came from transport out of Qin Prefecture and Fengxiang and from the tuntian of Xihe, with horses led over from Qing and Yuan Prefectures and grain and fodder carried on oxen and donkeys.
tactics: 王韶的用兵是一步一步把點構築起來的：先取熙州（狄道）作基地，築城、置路、屯田，控制洮水上游咽喉，切斷吐蕃與西夏之間的聯絡，再圖河、洮、岷。熙寧六年正月集兵，二月出師攻河州，步卒結長槍陣逼近城濠，弓弩手在外圍覆蓋城頭，器械隨後推進，攻勢一度登城，城內人心隨之瓦解，木征之妻瞎天牟與子續木洛被俘，木征出走。不料木征旋即集合殘部反攻奪回河州，王韶以孤軍深入、糧道未固為由退回熙州，保存實力再圖。八月再出，師過冶木河谷入洮州界，先破巴珍覺以斷木征後援，木征再次退出河州，宋軍才次第據有洮、岷諸州。行軍多用蕃部嚮導與通蕃語者，糧秣隨軍並以屯田接濟，攻城與野戰並重，不一味求速勝。熙寧七年二月河州復陷，王韶與李憲率二萬兵疾馳，逼退圍城之敵，隨後移師白城追擊，以一次大規模斬獲結束對木征的圍剿。事後編蕃民為蕃兵，設漢蕃屯田隊，把軍事勝利轉成可以自給的據點。
tacticsEn: Wang Shao's method was to build his position step by step. He first took Xizhou at Didao as a base, building walls, establishing the circuit and opening tuntian, so as to hold the upper throat of the Tao River, cut the link between Tibet and Western Xia, and only then move against He, Tao and Min. In the first month of the sixth year of Xining the troops were assembled; in the second month the army went out against He Prefecture: spearmen closed in on the ditch in ordered formations, bowmen covered the walls from outside, and siege engines were brought forward, the assault briefly mounting the ramparts as the defenders' nerve broke, Muzheng's wife Xiatianmou and son Xumuluo being captured and Muzheng himself fleeing. But Muzheng quickly gathered what was left of his forces and retook He Prefecture, and Wang Shao withdrew to Xizhou rather than press a single-handed and unsupported advance with an unsettled supply line, preserving his strength for another attempt. In the eighth month he marched out again, passed through Yemu Valley into Tao Prefecture, defeated Bazhenjue first so as to cut Muzheng's support, and Muzheng withdrew from He a second time; only then did the Song take Tao, Min and the other prefectures one by one. Tribal guides and men who spoke the Tibetan language were used on the march, grain moved with the army and was supplemented by tuntian, and the campaign balanced siege and manoeuvre in the field rather than simply chasing quick success. When He fell again in the second month of 1074, Wang Shao and Li Xian led twenty thousand men in a forced march, reached Ninghe and forced the besiegers to lift, then moved on to Baicheng to pursue and destroy them, ending the siege of Muzheng with a single large slaughter. Afterwards tribal people were enrolled as tribal soldiers and Han and Tibetan tuntian teams were formed, turning a military victory into a base that could feed itself.
data: 可查的數字散見於《宋史》與《熙河之役》條目，謹慎引用。熙寧六年二月首攻河州，斬殺木征部眾千餘人，俘獲木征之妻瞎天牟與其子續木洛。熙寧六年八月入洮州界，擊敗巴珍覺，記載未載斬首之數。熙寧七年二月河州被圍，王韶與李憲領兵二萬人疾馳熙州；其後在白城斬七千餘人，木征降宋，賜名趙思忠。《宋史·王韶傳》稱此役拓地二千餘里、招撫三十餘萬帳蕃漢百姓，數字或嫌其夸，難以逐條核實，但可見經營範圍遠及洮、岷、疊、宕數州。地理上，熙州（臨洮）沿洮水至河州（臨夏）約二百里，冶木河谷在臨洮以西，寧河即今甘肅和政，寧河與白城皆在河州一線。至元祐二年（1087），形勢又生變數：西夏與吐蕃阿里骨密約，劃定熙州、河州、岷州歸吐蕃，蘭州與定西城歸西夏，隨後阿里骨率十五萬圍河州，鬼章引兵二萬、自領五萬並造浮橋攻宋，圍南川寨八月未下，宋將姚兕破六逋宗城斬一千五百餘眾，種誼出哥龍谷斷其歸路，宋軍夜渡洮水破洮州，斬數千、溺死數千，可見熙河一線進退之劇。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are scattered in the Songshi and in the account of the Xihe campaign, and should be used with care. In the second month of the sixth year of Xining the first assault on He Prefecture killed more than a thousand of Muzheng's men and captured Muzheng's wife Xiatianmou and his son Xumuluo. In the eighth month of 1073 the Song entered Tao Prefecture and defeated Bazhenjue, though no casualty figure is recorded. In the second month of 1074 He Prefecture was besieged, and Wang Shao with Li Xian led twenty thousand men in a forced march to Xizhou; they afterwards cut down more than seven thousand men at Baicheng, and Muzheng surrendered and was given the name Zhao Si Zhong. The Songshi biography of Wang Shao states that the campaign opened up more than two thousand li of territory and won over some three hundred thousand tents of Tibetan and Han households; the figures may be inflated and cannot be checked item by item, but they show that the operation reached far across Tao, Min, Die and Dang. Geographically, Xizhou at modern Lintao is roughly two hundred li from He Prefecture at modern Linxia along the Tao River; Yemu Valley lies west of Lintao, and Ninghe is modern Hezheng, with Ninghe and Baicheng both on the line of He. In the second year of Yuanyou (1087) the situation turned again: Western Xia and the Tibetan leader Aligu concluded a compact assigning Xizhou, He and Min to Tibet and Lanzhou and Dingxi to Western Xia; Aligu then besieged He with a hundred and fifty thousand men, Guizhang brought in twenty thousand and led fifty thousand himself, built a floating bridge and invested Nanchuan Stockade for eight months without taking it, while the Song general Yao Xi broke Liubuzong city and killed more than fifteen hundred men, Zhong Yi came out through Golong Valley to cut the Tibetan retreat, and the Song army crossed the Tao River by night, took Tao Prefecture, killed several thousand by the sword and drowned several thousand in the crossing — the scale of the see-saw along the Xihe line.
cause: 熙河之役不是憑空而起。吐蕃可汗唃廝羅於治平二年（1065）病逝，第三子董氈繼位，吐蕃名分上仍號令諸部，實際上河湟一帶的部眾各自分立，木征在熙州河州一帶另立旗號；宋夏兩邊都看中這片土地，宋室視之為屏蔽西夏的藩籬，西夏則欲取河湟以厚國力。宋神宗熙寧變法，圖強兵開邊，志在「欲取西夏，先復河湟」；王韶進《平戎策》，主張先取河湟、遙制西夏右臂，並以招撫與屯田解決遠地供糧的老問題。朝廷阻力亦大，司馬光、韓琦等力言開邊耗財、力不能及，神宗力排眾議，詔令王韶便宜行事，於是熙寧六年正月集兵熙州，二月出師。戰端一開，事機又推著戰事向前：吐蕃內部木征與董氈、結董氈之間的矛盾，給了宋軍可乘之機，也讓這場戰役牽出宋、吐蕃、西夏三方在西北的角力。
causeEn: The Xihe campaign did not spring from nothing. The Tibetan khan Tasiluoge died in the second year of Zhiping (1065) and his third son Dongzhan succeeded him; Tibet still claimed authority over the tribes in name, but in practice the bands around Huangshui had split and Muzheng raised his own standard in the districts of Xi and He. Both Song and Western Xia set eyes on that ground: the Song court saw it as the shield wall covering Western Xia, while Western Xia wanted Huangshui to thicken its own strength. Under the Xining reforms Emperor Shenzong was seeking a strong army and wider borders, and the object was to recover Hehuang first in order to strike at Western Xia; Wang Shao submitted the Pingrong Plan, arguing that taking Hehuang would allow the Song to press on the right flank of Western Xia, and that recruiting and opening tuntian would solve the old problem of feeding an army far from the depots. Opposition in the court was strong — Sima Guang, Han Qi and others argued that opening the border would drain the treasury beyond the realm's strength — but Shenzong carried his point, ordered Wang Shao to act on his own discretion, and in the first month of the sixth year of Xining the troops were assembled at Xizhou and marched out in the second. Once the war began, circumstance pushed it forward: the quarrels inside Tibet between Muzheng and Dongzhan and Jie Dongzhan gave the Song its opportunity, and at the same time bound the campaign into a triangular struggle between Song, Tibet and Western Xia in the northwest.
impact: 此役是熙河開邊的起點，成果可分三層來看。第一層是地：宋於河、洮、岷、疊、宕一帶建州置縣，置熙河路，與秦鳳、涇原、環慶並為西北四路，宋自此在河湟有了一個可以屯田、可以轉運的立足點，對西夏右翼形成側翼壓力。第二層是人和地：招撫蕃漢百姓三十餘萬帳（傳世記載），編為蕃兵、設屯田隊，使秦州鳳翔一線的邊軍第一次有了自給的糧源與馬源，熙河亦成為茶、馬來源之一。第三層是代價與餘波：遠地開疆使轉運與守禦成本居高，士卒疲於役使，朝中攻擊不斷；王韶晚年因事貶黜，終不得盡其功，而熙寧七年河州一度得而復失，更顯示開邊並非一勞永逸。元祐四年（1089）司馬光執政，盡棄熙河、歸還四州，熙寧開邊的成果大半喪失，議者至今爭辯未休；直至崇寧年間宋廷再取湟州，河湟才真正回到中原王朝的版圖。而此役留下的辦法——以《平戎策》為綱、以屯田為糧、以招撫為主、每戰必先計糧——此後數百年都為西北經營所沿用。
impactEn: This campaign was the opening of the Xihe advance, and its results can be read on three levels. First, territory: the Song founded prefectures and counties across He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang and established the Xihe circuit, which, with Qinfeng, Jingyuan and Huanqing, became the fourth of the northwestern circuits, giving the Song a foothold in Huangshui where it could farm and transport supplies and from which it could press on the right of Western Xia. Second, people and land: the submission of some three hundred thousand tents of Tibetan and Han households (a transmitted figure) enrolled them as tribal soldiers and tuntian teams, so that for the first time the frontier armies of the Qin and Fengxiang lines had a local grain and horse supply, and Xihe became one of the sources of tea and horses. Third, cost and aftermath: holding distant new ground kept transport and defence expenses high, the soldiers were worn out by service, and attacks on the policy never ceased; Wang Shao was demoted in his later years and never saw the work finished, while the loss of He Prefecture in 1074 showed that opening the border was no single stroke to settle everything. In the fourth year of Yuanyou (1089), with Sima Guang in power, the Song abandoned Xihe and returned four prefectures, so that most of the gains of the Xining advance were lost, and the argument over the policy has never entirely died down; only in the Chongning era, when the court took Huangshui once more, did the region return to the map of a Chinese dynasty for good. The methods left behind by this campaign — the Pingrong Plan as the outline, tuntian as the supply, recruitment as the main way of winning people, and the reckoning of grain before every engagement — were followed in the northwestern frontier for centuries afterwards.
result: 熙寧六年二月，王韶發兵攻河州，斬殺木征部眾千餘人，俘其妻瞎天牟與子續木洛，木征出逃；不久木征反攻奪回河州，王韶退回熙州，首攻未竟。八月，宋軍過冶木河谷入洮州界，擊敗木征之弟巴珍覺，斷其外援，木征再退，宋軍遂取洮州，並置河、洮、岷、疊、宕諸州，設熙河路，拓地二千餘里。熙寧七年二月，木征聯合董氈與鬼章再攻河州，景思立輕敵戰敗而死，河州陷落；王韶時在汴京聞訊，與李憲率二萬兵疾馳熙州，至寧河逼退圍城之敵，繼而移師白城，斬七千餘人，木征出降，賜名趙思忠，熙河形勢根本逆轉。結果是：河、洮、岷一線歸宋所有，木征部眾被納入版籍與屯田，熙河開邊由一次戰役變成一項長期的邊防工程；代價則是遠征的士卒傷亡、浩繁的轉運軍費，以及元祐年間這份成果被整批交還、吐蕃重回舊地的政策逆轉。
resultEn: In the second month of the sixth year of Xining, Wang Shao marched against He Prefecture, killed more than a thousand of Muzheng's men, captured his wife Xiatianmou and his son Xumuluo, and Muzheng fled; but he soon gathered his remnants, retook He Prefecture, and Wang Shao withdrew to Xizhou, so that the first stroke failed of its aim. In the eighth month the Song army passed through Yemu Valley into Tao Prefecture, defeated Muzheng's brother Bazhenjue, cut off his relief, and Muzheng withdrew a second time, whereupon the Song took Tao Prefecture and established the prefectures of He, Tao, Min, Die and Dang and the Xihe circuit, opening up more than two thousand li. In the second month of 1074 Muzheng joined with Dongzhan and Guizhang and attacked He Prefecture again; Jing Sili was beaten and killed for overconfidence and He fell. Wang Shao, then at Bianjing, rode out with Li Xian and twenty thousand men, reached Ninghe and forced the besiegers away, then moved to Baicheng, killed more than seven thousand men and took Muzheng's submission, granting him the name Zhao Si Zhong, so that the whole Xihe situation was reversed. The result was that He, Tao and Min passed to the Song, the people of Muzheng's confederacy were entered in the registers and set to farm, and a single battle became a long-term frontier construction; the price was the lives of the soldiers on far campaigns, the vast cost of transport, and the eventual reversal in the Yuanyou years when the gains were handed back in a block and Tibet regained its old ground.
